::: {.custom-box}
To study convergence in $\tau$, we keep the spatial mesh size $h$ and rational order $m$ fixed and choose them sufficiently accurately that the temporal error dominates. The actual uniform steps are $\tau=T/N$, obtained from the requested step sizes using integer numbers of intervals. The expected temporal rate is first order. We fit $\log_{10}E=S_\tau\log_{10}\tau+\log_{10}C_\tau$ using those actual steps. Spatial, rational, and reference-quadrature errors should be checked independently so they do not mask the temporal rate.
For the experimental equation $u_t+\nu L^{\alpha/2}u=f$, keep $\nu>0$ fixed along each curve; constants can depend on it. This implementation is being tested before updating the paper.
:::


```{r, eval = TRUE}
# remotes::install_github("davidbolin/rspde", ref = "devel")
# remotes::install_github("davidbolin/metricgraph", ref = "devel")
library(rSPDE)
library(MetricGraph)
library(grateful)

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(plotly)
# Experiment results stay local; no Slack setup or uploads.
```







```{r}
# Parameters: start with an affordable pilot; choose "full" deliberately.
experiment_profile <- "pilot"
diffusion <- 1
run_id <- NULL # Set to a printed existing run ID to load it; do not recompute it.
run_refinement_checks <- TRUE
quadrature_order <- 4L
refinement_tolerance <- 0.05
T_final <- 1e-3
kappa <- 4
N_finite <- 4L
active_modes <- c(5L, 7L)
exact_initial <- c(10, 0)
exact_forcing <- c(0, 10)
AAA <- 1
OMEGA <- pi
alpha_vector <- seq(0.5, 1.5, by = 0.4)
stopifnot(experiment_profile %in% c("pilot", "full"))
tau_targets <- 10^seq(log10(9e-6), log10(1e-4), length.out = 4)
h_fixed <- if (experiment_profile == "pilot") 5e-4 else 1e-4
m_fixed <- 4L
time_grids <- lapply(tau_targets, function(dt) make_time_grid(T_final, dt))
tau_vector <- vapply(time_grids, function(grid) grid$time_step, numeric(1))
stopifnot(length(unique(tau_vector)) == length(tau_vector))
axis_values <- tau_vector
anchor_h <- h_fixed
anchor_grid <- time_grids[[which.min(tau_vector)]]
anchor_m <- m_fixed

# All grids, coefficients, and error-method settings are saved with this run.
experiment_parameters <- list(
  study = "tau", profile = experiment_profile, diffusion = diffusion,
  T_final = T_final, kappa = kappa, alpha = alpha_vector,
  modes = active_modes, N_finite = N_finite,
  initial = exact_initial, forcing = exact_forcing, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA,
  axis = axis_values, fixed = list(h = h_fixed, m = m_fixed),
  quadrature_order = quadrature_order, spatial_order = 8L,
  run_refinement_checks = run_refinement_checks,
  refinement_tolerance = refinement_tolerance, error_method = "modal-projection-v1")
run_dir <- experiment_run("tau", experiment_parameters, run_id = run_id)
cat("Run ID:", basename(run_dir), "\nResults:", run_dir, "\n")
```

The pilot is for checking behavior, not for claiming publication convergence
rates. In particular, the pilot in $m$ may reach a spatial or temporal floor.
The full profile retains the original solver grids, but uses the new modal
error calculation. No fine reference space-time mesh is allocated.

```{r, eval = FALSE, class.source = "fold-show"}
# Refuse to overwrite an existing run before starting any expensive work.
stopifnot(!file.exists(file.path(run_dir, "results.rds")))
errors_projected <- matrix(NA_real_, length(axis_values), length(alpha_vector))
diagnostics <- list()
evaluate_case <- function(spatial, alpha, m, grid) {
  tadpole_case_error(spatial, alpha, m, diffusion, grid,
    exact_initial, exact_forcing, AAA, OMEGA, quadrature_order, verbose = TRUE)
}
record_diagnostic <- function(spatial, alpha, m, h, dt) {
  diagnostic <- rational_accuracy_diagnostic(
    spatial$L, spatial$basis$C, alpha/2, kappa^2, m,
    spatial$basis$eigenvalues)
  diagnostic$h <- h
  diagnostic$time_step <- dt
  diagnostics[[length(diagnostics)+1L]] <<- diagnostic
}
spatial <- prepare_tadpole_experiment(h_fixed, kappa, active_modes, N_finite)
for (j in seq_along(alpha_vector)) {
  for (i in seq_along(time_grids)) {
    grid <- time_grids[[i]]
    errors_projected[i, j] <- evaluate_case(spatial, alpha_vector[j], m_fixed, grid)
    record_diagnostic(spatial, alpha_vector[j], m_fixed, h_fixed, grid$time_step)
  }
}

checks <- data.frame()
if (run_refinement_checks) {
  anchor_spatial <- prepare_tadpole_experiment(anchor_h, kappa, active_modes, N_finite)
  checks <- do.call(rbind, lapply(alpha_vector, function(alpha) {
    tadpole_refinement_checks(anchor_spatial, alpha, anchor_m, diffusion,
      anchor_grid, exact_initial, exact_forcing, AAA, OMEGA,
      quadrature_order, refinement_tolerance)
  }))
}
results <- list(errors_projected = errors_projected,
  diagnostics = do.call(rbind, diagnostics), refinement_checks = checks,
  parameters = experiment_parameters)
save_experiment_results(results, run_dir)
write.csv(results$diagnostics, file.path(run_dir, "rational_diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(checks, file.path(run_dir, "refinement_checks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(results$diagnostics)
print(checks)
```

```{r}
# Load only this run; metadata must match the parameters above.
results <- load_experiment_results(run_dir)
errors_projected <- results$errors_projected
```

```{r}
observed_rates <- numeric(length(alpha_vector))
for (u in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
  observed_rates[u] <- coef(lm(log10(errors_projected[, u]) ~ log10(tau_vector)))[2]
}

theoretical_rates <- rep(1, length(alpha_vector))


p_tau_tadpole <- error.convergence.plotter(x_axis_vector = tau_vector, 
                                   alpha_vector, 
                                   errors_projected, 
                                   theoretical_rates, 
                                   observed_rates,
                                   line_equation_fun = loglog_line_equation,
                                   fig_title = expression("Convergence in " * italic(tau)),
                                   x_axis_label = expression(italic(tau)))

p_tau_nicer_tadpole <- errorConvergencePlotterLatex(x_axis_vector = tau_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector, 
                                 errors_projected, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = loglog_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = "$\\mbox{Convergence in }\\tau$",
                                 x_axis_label = "$\\tau\\quad(\\log_{10}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 y_axis_label = "$\\|u-U_{h,m}^{\\tau}\\|_{L_2(\\Gamma\\times[0,T])}\\quad(\\log_{10}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 color_label = "$\\quad\\quad\\;\\;\\alpha\\;|\\;\\mathtt{theo}\\;|\\;\\;\\mathtt{obs}\\;\\;|\\%\\mathtt{re}$")

ggsave(file.path(run_dir, "conv_rates_tau_tadpole.png"), width = 4, height = 5, plot = p_tau_tadpole, dpi = 300)
myggsave(p_tau_nicer_tadpole, width = 4, height = 5, use_mathpazo = TRUE,
         output_dir = file.path(run_dir, "tikzpic"), copy_to_presentation = FALSE)
save(p_tau_tadpole, file = file.path(run_dir, "p_tau_tadpole.RData"))
save(p_tau_nicer_tadpole, file = file.path(run_dir, "p_tau_nicer_tadpole.RData"))
```


```{r, eval = FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width="400px", out.height="500px", fig.cap = captioner("Comparison between theoretical and observed convergence behavior for the $L_2(\\Gamma\\times(0,T))$-error with respect to $\\tau$ on a $\\text{log}_{10}$–$\\text{log}_{10}$ scale. Dashed lines indicate the theoretical rates, and solid lines represent the observed error curves. The legend below each plot shows the value of $\\alpha$ along with the corresponding theoretical ('theo'), and observed ('obs') rates for each case.")}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(run_dir, "tikzpic", "p_tau_nicer_tadpole_with_mathpazo.pdf"))
